natural_body: 40% SMB discount: +31% signups, +18% rev, -12% ret; judge at renewal

first.rationale: Verify the strongest directly relevant evidence: shortened onboarding improved completion and time-to-value, while signup simplification improved SMB activation. A guarded simplification experiment addresses both current declines without accepting the retention risk seen with discounting. Monitor qualified activation, conversion quality, and downstream retention rather than optimizing completion alone.
